correctness.rationale: For uniformly initialized position/heading and full Dirichlet absorption in bounded connected planar C² G, A_v=A0-v B with A0=-DΔ-D_R ∂φ²-Ω∂φ and B=eφ·∇. The skew terms disappear in Dirichlet L² energy, giving ∥B A0^{-1}∥≤1/(D√λ1), analytic perturbation for small |v| and even expansion by φ→φ+π. The adjoint at v=0 maps 1 to u0; integration by parts gives the quadratic correction -<Bu0,A0^{-1}Bu0>. In spatial Dirichlet eigenfunctions, first angular harmonics invert (a_j I+ΩJ) and yield χ=(2|G|)^{-1}Σ(|B_j1|²+|B_j2|²)a_j/(a_j²+Ω²), a_j=Dλj+D_R. Parseval and a_j>0 justify all s=Ω² derivatives, giving strict complete monotonicity. A separate skew-advection energy/Cauchy-Schwarz argument yields M(v,Ω)<M(0,Ω) for any v≠0; it does not imply arbitrary-v monotonicity in Ω. The proof explicitly allows D_R=0, because spatial Dirichlet coercivity remains.
